title: gh repo clone with --recurse-submodules sends auth to a non-GitHub submodule host
reason_not_testable: The credential leaves in the outbound git request to the submodule host, not in tool output, and PreToolUse/PostToolUse only see the command string and its stdout, so no fixture can observe the leak. Non-hook controls: sandbox network allowlist limiting egress to GitHub hosts; avoid --recurse-submodules with gh auth on untrusted repos.
